This is fundamentally a treasury/financial management capability focused on liquidity forecasting and cash position management.

None of the candidates address this need. All 8 candidates are procurement, material management, inventory, and vendor-focused resources. A meaningful match would require a treasury management system, payment processing API, or financial cash position data product — capabilities entirely absent from this candidate set.
